spans.s:
; अधर˚, बिंब˚.--ष्ठी A creeper
bearing a red fruit to which the
lip is commonly compared (बिंबफल).
In comp. the अ or आ of words
before ओष्ठ may be optionally
dropped, and the fem. may end in
आ or ई; as बिंबो(बौ) ष्ठा-ष्ठी. [cf. L.
ostium].
--Comp.
--अधरौ-रं the
upper and lower lip.
--उपमफला
the creeper Bryonia Grandis
(whose fruit resembles a lip).
--कोपः --प्रकोपः a disease of the
lips.
--ज a. labial (produced by
the lips).
--जाहं the root of the
lip.
--पल्लवः --वं a sprout-like or
tender lip.
--पुटं the cavity made by
opening the lips.
--पुष्पः --ष्पं the
tree वंधुक.
--रोगः any disease of the
lips.

ओष्ठक a. (At the end of comp.)
Taking care of the lips.
--कः A
lip.

ओष्ठ्य a. [ओष्ठ-यत्]
1 Being at
the lips.
--2 Belonging to the lips,
labial (as the sounds).
